about.description: WTI crude oil perpetual market. The contract tracks West Texas Intermediate crude oil using a futures-based reference price with scheduled contract rolls. Users get linear oil price exposure only, without owning physical crude, inventory claims, or a deliverable futures position. Pricing uses Felix’s external reference methodology for commodity markets. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDH. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the flx namespace, but are operated by Felix rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
